reviews.review: Epic Badass battles with a lot of story-line and excitement to keep u playing

Combat is super fast-paced and engaging, visuals are pretty good (I'm sure they were considered much better when the game released), level design can be a bit repetitive but it's not a huge deal. This game really makes you feel that power fantasy of being a space marine, especially when guardsmen look at you in awe, and slaughtering hordes of orks never gets old. 8/10.
It's a great game, but not worth it for such a high price

A  really well polished game: you can feel the weight beneath the bulk of the armour as you move, the weight of each strike, the terror in your enemies death scream. Contentedness and satisfaction grab hold of you as you play. You very easily gain a sense of flow when into the game: you learn to relax in a state of focus. Low respawn times in multiplayer, plenty of tactical options owed to three classes, perks, a decently sized assortment of weapons and elaborate map design- with features that may be advantageous to certain classes and features which aren't- lend themselves to soothing the feeling of frustration inherent to approaching the learning curve early on in the game. The campaign serves as a complete and adequate introduction to the multiplayer. It has good replayability in what concerns addressing different playing styles, with the mention that you get rather limited time as both the Assault and the Devastator classes.
Beware of a certain amount of lag in multiplayer: enemies may seem to teleport when dodge rolling/ evading. Most unpleasant thing finding yourself flanked by an enemy which you were about to strike from behind mere moments ago. Ensure you have a low latency by: using an internet cable, maybe set the game priority to high, maximum or real-time in task manager and closing any apps hogging bandwidth while playing.
One last thing: there are quite a few hardened players roaming about in multiplayer. They may make you throw your PC out the window during the first, I don't know, 70 hours of playtime. Being demolished by them becomes tolerable beyond that point. You will come across the chance to pay them back, and hopefully you will have learned enough to do so.  If you fancy the game persist and learn, you will get better. There are some comprehensive guides on Steam on playing the different classes. You can find them the easiest way by pressing shift-tab while in game.
In conclusion, 'tis a pretty good game. Beware of lag. May we meet in battle.
P.S. the most played game modes are Seize Ground- Classic and Exterminatus. You will most probably find players constantly within them.
